gbm_population_evidence.quote: Parts B and C: Previous histopathologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma and radiographic evidence of recurrence after prior therapy with radiotherapy.
While Part A may include patients with any type of HGG and any number of recurrences, Parts B and C are restricted to patients with glioblastoma experiencing first recurrence.

candidate_evidence.quote: 5-ALA will be administered as a sonosensitizer prior to CV01-delivered ultrasound and will be re-administered every 4 weeks prior to CV01 ultrasound delivery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study to Evaluate 5-ALA Combined With CV01 Delivery of Ultrasound in Recurrent High Grade Glioma

role_evidence.quote: The investigational product in this clinical study is a drug-device combination product consisting of 5-ALA HCl oral solution and the CV01 ultrasound delivery device.

agents.drug_class_hint: porphyrin precursor photosensitiser/sonosensitiser (Gleolan), used for sonodynamic therapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonosensitizer prior to CV01-delivered ultrasound to induce apoptosis of cancer cells

coder_notes: Part A any recurrent HGG (WHO 2021 astrocytoma grade 3/4, oligodendroglioma grade 3); Parts B/C recurrent glioblastoma only. GBM named in inclusion criteria, not in conditions. cns5 from explicit WHO classification 2021 citation. 5-ALA sonodynamic therapy = candidate, device_dependent. Ultrasound device not listed as agent. Part C surgical cohort described as exploratory but no tissue PK or PD measurement stated.
